name: Tank Confined Space Maintenance
narrative: During maintenance, a contractor entered the tank to inspect an internal valve. Gas testing was not recorded, the entry permit had expired, and no attendant was positioned outside.

name: Live Gas Line Valve Removal
narrative: Mechanical technician attempted to unbolt a pressurized gas line flange before closing isolation block valves. Stored energy was present without LOTO verification.

name: Suspended Casing Drop Zone
narrative: During rig operations, a roustabout was walking underneath the suspended load while the crane was slewing a 3-ton casing joint across the drill floor.

name: Derrick Work Without Fall Arrest
narrative: Derrickman was observed working at height on the monkey board 25 meters above ground without safety harness lanyard connected to the certified anchor point.

name: Hot Work Near Crude Separator
narrative: Contractor welder commenced torch cutting on pipe rack in Zone 1 hazardous area near separator without continuous LEL gas test and no fire watch posted.

name: Overridden High-Pressure Trip
narrative: Instrument technician installed an unauthorized electrical jumper to bypass the emergency high-pressure shutdown interlock on the main sales gas compressor.

name: Crew Carrier Speeding on Lease Road
narrative: Heavy utility truck transporting 6 field workers was driven at 85 km/h on unpaved wet rig access road with 3 passengers not wearing seatbelts.

name: H2S Sour Gas Flange Leak
narrative: Pinhole leak detected on sour gas gathering line emitting 15 ppm H2S. Area was evacuated immediately and wind socks checked; SCBA donned.

name: Minor Foot Trip on Access Path
narrative: Operator tripped over an uneven gravel verge while walking from administration block to cafeteria during daylight, resulting in minor dirt on coveralls.

name: Empty Pallet Stacking Housekeeping
narrative: Warehouse helper noticed five empty wooden shipping pallets stacked unevenly behind store room and restacked them neatly against the exterior wall.

name: Office Paper Shredder Jam
narrative: Clerical assistant experienced paper feed jam in office electric shredder. Power plug was disconnected from wall outlet before clearing paper fragments.

name: Drill Collar Rigging Slings Damaged
narrative: Pre-lift inspection by crane operator identified severe wire fraying on wire rope sling. Sling was immediately red-tagged and cut to prevent use.

name: Scaffold Tag Missing
narrative: Painter climbed temporary scaffold tower to touch up handrail paint before scaffold inspection green tag was signed off by competent scaffold builder.
